say.not_business_day: {day} is not a business day. The next business day I can record is {next}. Would that work for you?
say.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {deadline}. Would {deadline} work for you?
say.past: That date has already passed. Which day from today onward can you pay?
say.ask_exact: Could you tell me the exact day you can make the payment?
say.vague_propose_deadline: I need an exact day, so I can record {deadline}. Would that work for you?
say.error: I could not check that date. Could you tell me the day again?
